description: Draws the window's status line (model, effort, context, cost, five-hour limit) and reports that state to Officium's board, at most every ten seconds.

what: the model, effort, thinking and fast-mode settings
the context window's use and size
the session's cost, durations and lines added and removed
the five-hour and seven-day limit use and their reset times
the project folder, the git worktree, the repository and the pull request
the account's Officium heartbeat token, to authenticate
